title: Complete proof of Erdős Problem #1090: Monochromatic Collinear Points

problemStatement.plain: Formal investigation in geometry: Complete proof of Erdős Problem #1090: Monochromatic Collinear Points.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED & VERIFIED (0 axioms, 0 sorries). Refactored erdos1090_construction into a PALETTE-GENERIC core erdos1090_construction_colors (κ : Type) [Finite κ] — the Hales-Jewett generic-projection argument does not depend on the color type. The 2-coloring result (erdos1090_construction, κ=Bool) and the previously prose-only r-coloring generalization (erdos1090_generalized_holds : Erdos1090Generalized k r, κ=Fin r) are now both proved as instances. #print axioms on all three: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] only.
builtItems: erdos1090_construction_colors (κ : Type) [Finite κ] (k) (hk : k≥3): for ANY finite palette κ there is a finite A⊂ℝ² such that every κ-coloring has k monochromatic collinear points. Body = former erdos1090_construction proof with Bool→κ; Combinatorics.Line.exists_mono_in_high_dimension (Fin k) κ supplies the combinatorial line, geometry (dir=∑_{V} vⱼ, first coord=|V|≥1>0, injectivity) is palette-independent.
erdos1090_construction (k) (hk): 2-coloring result, now the κ=Bool instance of the generic core (binder-reorder to match MonochromaticKCollinear).
erdos1090_generalized_holds (k r): proves Erdos1090Generalized k r (was only a def + prose comment) as the κ=Fin r instance.
insights: Hales-Jewett already allows an arbitrary FINITE color type, and the generic linear projection [k]^ι → ℝ² is defined without reference to the palette — so once the 2-coloring construction is written palette-generically, the r-coloring generalization is FREE (a one-line Fin r instantiation). No new geometry is needed to go from 2 colors to r.

Making the color type a parameter (rather than re-proving) is the DRY win: erdos1090_construction and erdos1090_generalized_holds share one ~90-line proof. Only the final monochromatic step needed a binder reorder (∀ p q, p∈S→q∈S vs ∀ p∈S, ∀ q∈S) to match the Bool-side MonochromaticKCollinear shape.
The r≥2 hypothesis in Erdos1090Generalized is inessential for existence (a monochromatic line exists even for r=1); kept only to mirror the classical statement.
nextSteps: Quantitative upper bound on ramseyNumber k (currently only ramsey_lower_bound ≥ k).
Prove the higher-dimensional analogue Erdos1090HigherDim (planes in ℝ^d) — Mathlib Hales-Jewett projects to ℝ^d just as it does to ℝ².
